The user wants to set the log level of `svc-beacon-479` to `debug` and check the status of bucket `bucket-audit-3069`.
Following the runbook:
Step 1: Read ticket (Done).
Step 2: GET `/api/services/svc-beacon-479` to check current status.
Step 3: POST `/api/tickets/TCK-243490/token` to get a token.
Step 4: POST `/api/services/svc-beacon-479/log-level` with `level: debug` and the token.
Step 5: call `cloud_stat` for `bucket-audit-3069`.
Step 6: `submit_report`.

Current step is Step 2: GET `/api/services/svc-beacon-479`.
